#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

bool ok(long long W, long long M, long long x) {
    if (x == M) return true;
    x += M;
    while (x > 0) {
        if (x % W > 1) return false;
        x /= W;
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    long long W, M;
    cin >> W >> M;
    if (W == 2) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<long long> powers;
    powers.push_back(1);
    powers.push_back(W);
    long long cur = W;
    while (true) {
        if (cur > 10000000000LL / W) break;
        cur *= W;
        powers.push_back(cur);
    }
    vector<long long> sums;
    sums.push_back(0);
    for (long long p : powers) {
        size_t oldSize = sums.size();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < oldSize; i++) {
            sums.push_back(sums[i] + p);
        }
    }
    bool found = false;
    for (long long x : sums) {
        if (ok(W, M, x)) {
            found = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    cout << (found ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
